title: Diane Powell takes on John Mack's legacy and a synchronous Oregon house

tellings.quote: he dies he gets hit by a car very tragically in London and she goes to his memorial and I guess all the people at the memorial are like uh Dr Powell you have to take on uh Dr John Max's Legacy

plain: When John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist known for studying people who say aliens took them, was killed by a car in London in 2004, people at his memorial told the psychiatrist Diane Powell she had to take on his legacy. Michels tells this himself, passing on Powell's story, and it leads into an account of a house in Oregon tied to a striking coincidence. He tells it as the moment Powell's own work on the mind's unexplained abilities was handed a torch.
